leads.title: Gender Recognition Act 2009 (c.11)
leads.documents: Legal basis for transgender persons to change legal gender and have new gender recognised in Isle of Man
leads.detail: Cited in text as Gender Recognition Act 2009 (c.11)

leads.title: Equality Act 2017 - Slattys Cormid 2017
leads.documents: Lists gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, sex among protected characteristics; defines sexual orientation; phased in with much in force 1 January 2019
leads.detail: Cited as Equality Act 2017; royal assent 18 July 2017; approved by House of Keys 7 March 2017

leads.title: Human Rights Act 2001
leads.documents: Incorporation of European Convention on Human Rights into Manx law, following UK example

leads.title: Sexual Offences and Obscene Publications Act 2021
leads.documents: Pardon scheme for historical gay sex offences pre-1992 based on UK Alan Turing law; includes ban on sexual orientation and gender identity conversion therapy added 2020, in effect 2024
leads.detail: Passed July 2021 with royal assent, effective by proclamation 1 July 2022; conversion therapy amendment added in Legislative Council

leads.title: Employment Act 2006 (c.21)
leads.documents: Made it unlawful to dismiss employees on grounds of sexual orientation
leads.detail: Cited as Employment Act 2006 (c.21), took effect 1 September 2006

leads.title: Civil Partnership Act 2011 (c.2)
leads.documents: Legalised civil partnerships for same-sex couples and granted equal access to full joint or stepchild adoption
leads.detail: Signed into law 15 March 2011, took effect 6 April 2011

leads.title: Same-sex marriage legislation 2016
leads.documents: Repealed bar on same-sex marriage; legalised same-sex marriage including conversion of civil partnerships
leads.detail: Bill introduced House of Keys 2 Feb 2016, passed Keys 8 March 17-3, Council 26 April 6-3, royal assent 19 July 2016, effective 22 July 2016

leads.title: Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2006 (c.3)
leads.documents: Lowered age of consent to 16, gender-neutral for all sexual conduct regardless of gender and sexual orientation

leads.title: Sexual Offences Act 1992 - Sections 9 and 10
leads.documents: Retained criminalisation of buggery/gross indecency between men if under 16 or elsewhere than in private; defines not in private; amended 2021 to delete more than two persons present and make public indecency language gender-neutral
leads.detail: Cited as Section 9 and Section 10 of Sexual Offences Act 1992, amended 2021

leads.title: Isle of Man Government hate crime bill community consultation - July 2022
leads.documents: Proposed hate crime bill explicitly including sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status and gender reassignment
leads.detail: Described as community consultation progressed July 2022
